# Code of conduct

## Our standard

Treat every person in this project with respect. Disagree with ideas, not with people.

## Unacceptable behavior

- Insults, personal attacks or harassment of any kind.
- Sharing the private information of another person without consent.
- Any conduct that is not acceptable in a professional setting.

## Reporting a problem

Send a report to dev@amsys.cz. The maintainer reads and answers each report.

## Enforcement

A maintainer who breaks this code has the same consequences as anyone else.
